title: Invite no-mail outcome copy: the QA checklist row and the ObjectView invite-outcome test fixture still quote the old Copy Invite Link sentence (follow-up to #34889)
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CZiaBg6rk7dpy1s9Me

Filing gate: ② out-of-scope finding owed by the L1 ACCEPT of PR #35274 (comment 6997094395, 范围外去向). ⛔ Not a claim; triage sets lane and grade.

## What PR #35274 makes false

PR #35274 (#34889) rewrote the no-mail `link_only` outcome of the four `invite_user` mirrors and `resend_invitation` in `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/invite-outcome-messages.ts`: it no longer tells the admin to "Use Copy Invite Link on the invitation to share it."; it states the verified-address rule and the operator path. Two in-repo readers still quote the old sentence:

1. `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/ux-conventions.json` (~line 27), a `knownGaps` entry "FIXED, regression row, expected PASS (objectui#11817)", quotes the old `link_only` toast word for word as the expected copy. The next checklist run of that row on a no-mail deployment will score FAIL against a correct product.
2. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.inviteOutcome-27797.test.tsx` keeps a local `LINK_ONLY_TAIL` fixture with the old sentence. It stays green (it does not read the producer) but no longer mirrors what the server answers.

Neither is published.

## Done when

- The checklist row's expected toast quotes the current producer text (or names the outcome by key rather than by sentence, so it does not drift again).
- The test fixture mirrors the current `link_only` text, or reads it from the producer.

## Reader

Whoever holds `docs/qa/platform-checklist/**` and `ui/packages/app-shell` invite-outcome tests. Size XS, text/test only.

Dedupe: open-issue search `ux-conventions.json Copy Invite Link` and `LINK_ONLY_TAIL` → none.
